definition: InvariantOnlyDefinition f means ∀ s, objective s ↔ Stable f s. It omits actual truth and can classify an invariably false sentence as objective.
note: Analyst rival calibration, not an attribution to a historical school. It may coextend with actual-stable calibration in some profiles; no exclusivity or philosophical identity follows. The control shows why this interpretation cannot supply objective-implies-truth in general.
